Conditional CDF and quantile function from sorted QR predictions

Source: R/quantile-helpers.R
qr_cdf.Rd

Evaluate the conditional CDF (qr_cdf) or quantile function (qr_quantile) for each row of q_sorted by linear interpolation between the estimated quantiles (tau_k, Q(tau_k)). Interpolating, rather than using a step function, avoids rounding ranks down to the quantile grid, which biases CiC-type counterfactuals.

Beyond the grid the functions are flat: qr_cdf returns tau_1 below the first quantile and tau_K above the last, and qr_quantile returns the first (last) quantile for p below tau_1 (above tau_K). In simulations, extrapolating with exponential tails reduced bias only slightly under normal errors and badly hurt heavy-tailed (t3) designs, and estimating extra extreme quantiles added more variance than it removed bias.

Usage

qr_cdf(q_sorted, taus, y)

qr_quantile(q_sorted, taus, p)

Arguments

q_sorted

matrix from qr_sorted_quantiles().

taus

quantile levels, fit$tau.

y, p

numeric vectors with one value per row of q_sorted.

Value

numeric vector, one value per row of q_sorted.
